race.comment: CLASSIC RULER (9) won three back before missing at his past couple. Pike remains on board today though after bumping into a smart one a couple of weeks ago. May be able to slot into a better position this time and can get back to his best. CHOUX SHOE (4) is knocking on the door, missing by 1.2L over this track and trip last time out. On the quick turnaround this time and Tsang's claim comes in handy. Likely to be in the second half of the field and she can be finishing off strongly once again. CENTRE BOND (1) resumed in good order over 1200m at Pinjarra when off a 305-day break. He should be better for the first-up run and he is a second-up winner in the past. Watch for him flying late in the race. ABOUT TURN (5) was too good from the front last start at Pinjarra and everything looks to map similarly this time around. Third-up now and can build on that performance. RADIANT LIGHT (8) just missed last time out as favourite and has to be included.
